summary: Retained model-loading, multimodal warmup, and exact startup-plan optimizations for frequently restarted model-serving containers.

delivery.application_guard: Export the complete vllm Python package from source.code_commit. Do not copy only the changed files onto the v0.27.1 Python package.
delivery.configuration_guard: A profile/configuration run may select an existing image for this patch set, but must not build it.

components.reason: Move processor warmup off the serial engine-start critical path while retaining warmup behavior.
components.removal_condition: Remove after an equivalent upstream implementation is present in the pinned base.

components.reason: Expose queue depth, reader count, bounce-buffer size, copy-block size, and direct-I/O selection through model_loader_extra_config.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the installed vLLM and FastSafetensors releases expose equivalent validated controls.

components.reason: Avoid materializing non-local Qwen byte ranges and avoid duplicate MTP embedding and lm_head loads.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the Qwen implementations upstream provide equivalent filtering and weight sharing.

components.reason: Use aligned O_DIRECT reads for cold selected ranges and buffered reads for resident checkpoints.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the behavior is available in compatible released vLLM and FastSafetensors versions.

components.reason: Persist and reuse an exact KV allocation so redundant multimodal memory profiling can be skipped without disabling compilation, warmup, sampling, or CUDA graphs.
components.removal_condition: Remove after the pinned vLLM release persists the exact allocation with equivalent fingerprinting and invalidation.

dependencies.name: fastsafetensors
dependencies.reason: Provides bounded parallel no-GDS reads and adaptive aligned O_DIRECT support required by this patch set.

tested_runtime.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

compatibility.source_rule: The Python source is pinned to source.code_commit, which is based on source.base_commit from upstream/main and is not the v0.27.1 release source tree.
compatibility.porting_rule: For a different vLLM source release, port the five commits, update this manifest, and repeat unit, startup, correctness, memory, and serving-performance gates before deployment.

validation.storage_state: Targeted checkpoint ranges cold; compiler and JIT caches persistent and warm.
recorded_tests: 76 FastSafetensors core and range tests passed
17 focused vLLM loader and configuration tests passed
14 focused worker and renderer-warmup tests passed
Focused ruff and formatting checks passed
validation.remaining_gate: Run representative TTFT, ITL, throughput, and peak-memory checks on the final derived image before wider rollout.

excluded_experiments.reason: Below the agreed materiality threshold and adds cache invalidation surface.
Constructor-only gain with no stable end-to-end win.
Below the agreed materiality threshold and model-specific maintenance cost.

external_fleet_requirements: Keep the shared-role FlashInfer 0.6.16 Python 3.11 shim that inserts 'from __future__ import annotations' in fd_exchange.py.
Keep the shared-role dependency pins fastapi==0.136.3, starlette==0.52.1, and prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator==7.1.0.
Inject Hugging Face credentials through the fleet secret mechanism; do not place tokens in the image, manifest, profile, or service unit.

rollback.method: Select the prior stock image and remove the patch-set-specific loader configuration and startup-plan opt-in.
rollback.data: The startup-plan directory is regenerable cache data and may remain on disk; incompatible fingerprints and schema versions are ignored.
